current_activity: The 246th Infantry Division holds Aachen; OB West accepts its possible loss and orders the city held to the last
notes: Event date: Schramm, OKW war diary, p. 404, entry of 9 October: "Aachen bis zum letzten zu verteidigen" ... "befohlen worden"; "Der etwaige Verlust der 246. Inf.-Div. müsse in Kauf genommen" ... "werden". Event definition: the order of 9 October; CMH dates the division's arrival at the end of September (ch. 12 p. 283). Event support: one OKW war diary entry. Location: Aachen with a precision of 5 km. Location approximate: a town point for the garrison. Location support: the war diary names Aachen. Commander: Colonel Gerhard Wilck. Opponents: US First Army (VII and XIX Corps).

current_activity: Wilck takes over the Aachen garrison and sets up his headquarters in the Palast-Hotel Quellenhof
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 13 p. 307: Leyherr was relieved "in deference to the arrival of his division commander, Colonel Wilck"; "Colonel Wilck established his headquarters in the Palast-Hotel Quellenhof, a luxurious Kurhotel in Farwick Park in the northern portion of the city". Event definition: the takeover two days after the first surrender ultimatum; CMH has the ultimatum delivered on 10 October, so 12 October is an inferred date. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Aachen with a precision of 3 km; the hotel is in the northern part of the city and no coordinate for it is given by CMH. Location approximate: a town point. Location support: CMH names the hotel and the city. Commander: Colonel Gerhard Wilck. Opponents: US 1st Infantry Division.

current_activity: Wilck surrenders the Aachen garrison at 1205 at a bunker on Lousberg Strasse
engaged_note: the 26th Infantry (1st Infantry Division) took the surrender
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 13 p. 316: "At Colonel Corley's headquarters, the assistant division commander, Brig. Gen. George A. Taylor, accepted the German surrender. At 1205 on 21 October, it was over.". Event definition: the surrender of the Aachen garrison; the division as a whole did not surrender (other elements were outside the city), so no destruction flag is set. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Aachen, the air-raid bunker at the northern end of Lousberg Strasse, with a precision of 3 km. Location approximate: a town point. Location support: CMH names the bunker and the city. Commander: Colonel Gerhard Wilck.
